infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: IWILLBUILD uses your camera to capture job photos, receipts, incidents, and site evidence for your work records.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: IWILLBUILD uses your photo library so you can upload job photos, receipts, and site evidence.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: IWILLBUILD saves captured photos to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: IWILLBUILD uses your location for job travel, fleet tracking, and site attendance records.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: IWILLBUILD uses your location in the background to track active drive sessions for fleet management.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: IWILLBUILD uses your location in the background to track active drive sessions for fleet management.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: IWILLBUILD uses the microphone for voice notes and dictation where enabled.
